title: B at 2 s: four solver paths on one colour range
caption: Top: mid-plane slice with the membrane outline. Bottom: B on the cut-away membrane with the A particles.
simulations: One seed per path, conversion (20,000 A → B, k = 0.5), recorded every 0.25 s to 2 s into vcell-fenics results bundles (sims/render_3d.py); the native bundle has fields only.
interpretation: Every path converts the same 20,000 molecules, so the level of B shows each path's PDE volume: VCell's staircase (27.7 µm³; native and 'none'), the accessible volume (24.6 µm³; 'adapters+volumes', which matches the particles' smooth domain) and the Netgen mesh (27.3 µm³). The ~1% near-membrane depletion of the uncorrected paths is below single-seed noise; the 16-seed metrics resolve it. The staircase panels also show the exterior band the particles see (fields extended by the fold map).
